description: Local stdio MCP server for read-only Freebox discovery, pairing coordination, and system/network status.
name: org.freenaute/freenaute-freebox-mcp

environmentVariables.name: FREEBOX_APPLICATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Freebox application identifier registered during pairing; defaults to org.freenaute.freebox-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: FREEBOX_APPLICATION_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Display name presented on the Freebox during pairing.

environmentVariables.name: FREEBOX_DEVICE_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Client device name presented on the Freebox during pairing; defaults to the machine name.

environmentVariables.name: FREEBOX_ALLOW_PAIRING_INITIATION
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in policy switch. Pairing initiation is allowed only when set exactly to '1', 'true', or 'TRUE'.

environmentVariables.name: FREEBOX_SERVER_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Freebox server base address passed to the Freebox client.

environmentVariables.name: FREEBOX_CREDENTIAL_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to an AES-256-GCM encrypted credential file (container/headless mode). When set, it takes priority over the OS vault and FREEBOX_CREDENTIAL_PASSPHRASE_FILE must point to the passphrase file.

environmentVariables.name: FREEBOX_CREDENTIAL_PASSPHRASE_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the file containing the passphrase used to derive the AES-256 key for FREEBOX_CREDENTIAL_FILE.
